text:
Michelle L: Quick status check — putting together the final punchlist for the EU dedicated capacity buildout next week. Can owners confirm current ETA and any blockers? Key items I care about: procurement ETA, rack/cable readiness, firmware/firmware signoff, KMS integration for private nodes, and any reservation gaps we need to patch.

Ali (infra): Procurement update — vendor confirmed bulk shipment but one container (cont-7) shifted +48h. Total H100 count still matches order but arrival will be staggered. ETA for first rack-level drop: 3 days from now. Missing 2x cable kits in the packing list (we flagged to vendor). PR: #5432 tracks the vendor convo.

Tom L - logistics: Manifest updated: https://internal.assets/manifest/cont-7 (shared). I queued overnight for the missing cable kits, ETA next morning. If cont-7 is delayed we can prioritize racks 9/10 for early canary since they already have full cablekits.

Samir: Cluster readiness: PXE images baked and smoke tests passing on staging. One firmware job (FW-1234) needs a maintenance window — it reboots nodes and updates BMC. Requesting a 60-minute window during low traffic on Tue night. Playbook to run on nodes:

```
ansible-playbook -i inventory/eu_gpu site.yml --tags=firewall,firmware,smoke
```

Also saw two nodes in rack-11 with mismatched NVMe firmware; opened ticket INF-998.

Jordan P: Reservation / capacity mapping note — SLOTS-556 currently reserved as burst capacity; to meet customer commitments we need to convert 10 nodes to the dedicated pool by the 4th day after arrival. Can infra/infra-ops confirm the config change? There's a small config tweak in the reservations service (repo: infra/capacity-configs, branch: convert-s56).

Ali (infra): I can take the reservations change but need a quick CR review from @Jordan P and @Michelle L. Also we need KMS policy update for the private nodes: the customer KMS key needs to be whitelisted in the appliance ACL prior to bringing nodes online — pinging security for the key ID.

erica-devex: I'll update the runbooks and quickstart with the new reservation flow and the change notes. Adding a short checklist in the docs with owners so oncall can follow the canary. Draft: https://docs.internal/runbooks/dedicated-buildout-eu (WIP).

Michelle L: Owners for the checklist: procurement -> Tom L, hardware bring-up/firmware -> Samir, reservations/config -> Ali, docs -> erica-devex, security/KMS -> Jordan P to coordinate with security. If any of these are wrong speak now.

Jordan P: Correct on KMS ownership, I'll open sec ticket SEC-214 and add the KMS key ID once we have the vendor manifest. Also can someone confirm whether the dedicated pool needs the new node label `dedicated:europe` in the scheduler? That's required for rollout gating.

Samir: Yes scheduler needs that label. We'll add it during the ansible run; the playbook will set labels after firmware step. Sample label command for reference: `kubectl label nodes <node> dedicated=europe --overwrite`.

Ali (infra): Small blocker: our ip-alloc plan shows a 10-address gap for the new racks if we carve the dedicated pool as-is. Either we shrink the subnet used for ephemeral or we allocate a /26 more. I'll post the IP plan in infra channel in 10m.

Tom L - logistics: Re cablekits — I have tracking numbers and will forward to @Ali (infra). If the cablekits don't arrive in time we have a fallback to reuse spare kits from staging for the canary racks.

oncall-bot: NOTE: There is a scheduled maintenance window for rack-3 on 3789002000 — verify no customer-critical routes using that rack.

Michelle L: Action items summary: 1) Ali to post IP plan + confirm reservation CR timeline (owner) 2) Samir to book maintenance window and run firmware playbook 3) Tom to confirm cablekit ETA and fallback spares 4) Jordan to open SEC-214 and coordinate KMS whitelist 5) erica-devex to publish runbook checklist draft. Please respond with quick ack or add blockers. :eyes:

Ali (infra): Ack — I'll post IP plan and aim to have reservation CR ready for review within 6 hours. :thumbsup:

Samir: Ack — will book Tue night window and post exact time.

Tom L - logistics: Ack. Shipping updates will land in 30m.

erica-devex: Ack — I'll push the runbook and tag owners when done.

Jordan P: Ack — starting SEC-214 and will add KMS details once manifest available.

Michelle L: Great — if anything slides on the container delay we reconvene async here. Otherwise I'll compile these into the milestone doc by EOD and flag any ripcord steps. :sparkles:
